title: Premium Response
description: Response payload from the pricing-policy service containing the computed premium breakdown.

request_id.description: Echoed idempotency key from the corresponding premium request.

policy_id.description: Identifier of the policy this premium applies to.

base_premium.description: Base premium amount before dynamic adjustments, derived from actuarial tables.

dynamic_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the base premium based on risk scores and behavioural incentives. Values < 1 indicate a discount; > 1 indicate a surcharge.

final_premium.description: Final premium amount (base_premium × dynamic_multiplier), after rounding and regulatory floors/caps.

adjustment_pct.description: Percentage adjustment. Negative = discount, positive = surcharge.

discount_breakdown.description: Itemised breakdown of adjustments that contribute to the dynamic multiplier (optional).

valid_until.description: ISO-8601 timestamp after which this quote expires and must be re-computed.

computed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when this premium was computed.

score_detail.description: Risk scoring details that informed the premium calculation.
